compute_sha256_fileobj: compute the sha256 hash of a binary file object using sha_fileobj
compute_git_hash: compute the git-sha1 hash of bytes data using git_hash
hash_file_with_chunk_size: hash a file object with a custom chunk size for sha256 computation
generate_git_object_hash: generate a git object hash from raw bytes data
verify_file_integrity: verify file integrity by computing its sha256 hash with sha_fileobj
